title.en: FSTel - Telemetry & Virtual Button Box Exporter
title.fr: FSTel - Télémétrie et Boîte à Boutons Virtuelle

description.en: FSTel streams comprehensive real-time telemetry from your in-game tractor and attached implements to external dashboards (Android app and modern web browsers). Includes high-precision speed, RPM, engine load, fuel/AdBlue levels, hydraulics, PTO, folding states, fill levels, pipe position, and environment info at up to 30Hz.
description.de: FSTel überträgt umfassende Echtzeit-Telemetriedaten Ihres Traktors und Ihrer Anbaugeräte an externe Dashboards (Android-App und Webbrowser).
